name: Logisim
description: Runs Logisim's truth-table mode and compares the generated table with the key.
author: Red Pen

keyInput.label: Key truth table
keyInput.help: Add one row per truth-table line. The adapter also accepts rows pasted with spaces or | separators.

settings.label: Logisim executable
settings.help: The path to logisim-evolution or logisim. The adapter runs it directly; no Python or other runtime is needed.
